turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The shuttle leaves the station at dawn, and nobody must know our route.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I checked the manifest twice. Every crate is sealed and accounted for.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. If the inspector asks, we were never on this platform.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: You two worry too much. The south gate has been unguarded for years.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That is exactly what worries me, Daniel. Unguarded gates invite trouble.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Trouble is my middle name, remember? Relax and enjoy the ride.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Enough. Mara, take the lantern and lead us through the service tunnels.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The tunnels flood after midnight. We have maybe twenty minutes of dry floor.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Then we run. I did not bring these boots to keep them clean.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Wait. Do you hear that? Someone is following us through the dark.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Footsteps. Two sets, maybe three. They are not even trying to hide.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It could be the night watch. Or it could be much worse than that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Kill the lantern. Nobody speaks until I give the signal.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Signal received. Moving to the east corridor now, quiet as mice.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: East corridor is clear. Whatever followed us turned back at the gate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Then we made it. Dawn is coming, and the shuttle will not wait for us.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Next time, Captain, remind me to volunteer for a quieter mission.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: There will not be a next time if we miss this departure. Move!
